# coreapp-v1_transaction_pipeline (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) TransactionPipelineSpec defines the Run instance of a pipeline. It refers a pipeline definition by name and contains runtime
parameters to run pipeline(s). It is used as input to create a TransactionPipeline CR, which will trigger the execution of the pipeline(s). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Optional

- `alarms` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--alarms))
- `api_version` (String)
- `deviations` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--deviations))
- `kind` (String)
- `name` (String) name of the TransactionPipeline
- `namespace` (String) the namespace scope in which to operate
- `status` (Attributes) TransactionPipelineStatus defines the observed state of TransactionPipeline
Contains runtime information and parsed/derived fields (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `name` (String)
- `namespace` (String)

Optional:

- `annotations` (Map of String)
- `labels` (Map of String)


<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `pipeline_definitions` (Attributes List) Reference to the PipelineDefinition, which needs to be run (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--pipeline_definitions))

Optional:

- `target` (List of String) Target specifies which cluster(s) to run the pipeline on
Defaults to "Main" if not specified
- `transaction_id` (Number) The transaction id which triggered this pipeline run and is going to be committed after all the pre-commit jobs are successful.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--pipeline_definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.pipeline_definitions`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the PipelineDefinition CR to run

Optional:

- `namespace` (String) Namespace of the PipelineDefinition CR to look for,
defaults to the system namespace.



<a id="nestedatt--alarms"></a>

Optional:

### Nested Schema for `deviations`

Optional:

- `count` (Number)


<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Optional:

- `completion_time` (String) CompletionTime is when the pipeline execution completed
- `id` (Number) Unique ID for this pipeline execution, can be used for tracking logs and events
- `job_statuses` (Attributes Map) JobStatuses tracks the status of individual jobs, keyed by the jobID (which is the job key in the pipeline spec). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--job_statuses))
- `start_time` (String) StartTime is when the pipeline execution started
- `state` (String) State represents the current state of pipeline execution

<a id="nestedatt--status--job_statuses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.job_statuses`

Optional:

- `completiontime` (String) CompletionTime is when the job completed
- `starttime` (String) StartTime is when the job started
- `state` (String) Phase represents the current phase of job execution
- `workflowid` (String) workflow-id is the ID of the workflow instance created for this job, if this job is
of workflowGVK type
